blocks.text: Fourteen days from Rio de Janeiro to Buenos Aires: Christ the Redeemer and Sugar Loaf, two nights in an Amazon ecolodge, the Afro-Brazilian soul of Salvador and the beaches of Praia do Forte, the Iguazu Falls and a tango evening in Buenos Aires, with excursions on a shared basis with English-speaking guides.
